items.title: Kaufland Romania Achieves €4bn In Revenue In 2025 Financial Year

items.title: Investments in stores and assortment lead Wibra to a new record year
items.summary: Last year, Wibra once again saw its revenue rise by more than a quarter. This growth is not solely due to new store openings; existing stores are also performing strongly. The discount retailer still sees plenty of opportunities in the Netherlands, Belgium, and France.

items.title: Gruppo Selex Targets 4.5% Revenue Growth In 2026
items.summary: Gruppo Selex is targeting revenue of €23.3 billion in FY 2026, or 4.5% growth compared to the €22.3 billion reported in 2025.

items.title: Jorian van Acker heads Mondelez Benelux with clear goal: one billion euros in revenue
